Article 10 — Dividends

1. Dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

2. However, such dividends may be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident and according to the laws of that State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends. This English text is the UN Treaty Series translation; the authentic treaty texts control.

Article 11 — Interest

Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed only in that other State, subject to the permanent-establishment / fixed-base exception and the arm's-length limitation for excessive interest. This English text is the UN Treaty Series translation; the authentic treaty texts control.

Article 12 — Royalties

Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable in that other State. Royalties referred to in paragraph 3(a) may also be taxed in the source State, but the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties. Paragraph 3(a) covers patents, trademarks, designs/models, plans, secret formulae/processes, equipment and know-how; paragraph 3(b) covers copyright of literary, artistic or scientific works including cinematographic films. This English text is the UN Treaty Series translation; the authentic treaty texts control.

Article 12(2): However, the royalties mentioned in sub-paragraph a) of paragraph 3 may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

Article 12(3)(b): any copyright of literary, artistic or scientific work including cinematograph films and films or tapes for television or radio broadcasting.

Article 12(2): However, the royalties mentioned in sub-paragraph a) of paragraph 3 may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

Article 12(3)(a): any patent, trade mark, design or model, plan, secret formula or process, computer software, or industrial, commercial or scientific equipment, or for information concerning industrial, commercial or scientific experience.
